facts.fact: The Watiqa portal, run since 2012 under the Ministry of Interior, lets citizens order birth extracts, full birth certificates, marriage-file copies and consular registration certificates online for delivery by post, and had logged over 1.847 million birth-extract and 1.31 million full-copy requests by 18 October 2026, per the outlet reading the portal's homepage.
